_doc: Default kill rules of scripts/colab/lab/line_guard.py (backlog GUARD; docs: the RULE fields in line_guard.py --help). Thresholds from the 2026-11-06 retrospective: E2 approx_kl 0.4..1e6 from its first update (normal 0.002-0.004); E3 push_clamped 0.89-0.93; G explore_pmass_macro.ChooseRestOption 0.34 -> 7e-28 in 48 updates and sps ~4,500 vs C3 ~11,100; E-prime loss 1.1e14 at u7676 then NaN; G dev-128 0.398 vs fork 0.489. A line's spec may copy this file and tighten or relax it; set warmup_updates there for a fork whose first updates are legitimately noisy.

rules.name: kl_high
rules._why: median of 10 so a fork's few early spikes (G 0.11 at +6) do not fire; normal lines run 0.002-0.004

rules.name: push_clamped_high
rules._why: the bounded push is saturated: E3 0.84-0.95 from its first update; G 0.15-0.67, mean 0.40

rules.name: pmass_collapse
rules._why: the policy's own mass on a targeted row fell below a tenth of its first-5 level for 3 updates; rows whose mass was already ~0 (min_ref) are not judged

rules.name: sps_slow
rules._why: per-update env steps / t_total_s against the control run's median after the fork; needs --control

rules.name: loss_nonfinite
rules._why: the trainer itself only stops on a non-finite loss; E-prime wrote 1.1e14 the update before

rules.name: dev_window_vs_fork
rules._why: EV5 KILL: mean of the last <=3 dev-128 greedy-off evals is 0.04 below the fork-point eval and the 95% interval excludes 0; needs --fork-run (or --fork-eval)

rules.name: dev_below_floor
rules._why: boss-school-plan-2026-11-06 abandon rule: three consecutive eval points < 0.42
